_why: root_module_ratchet.py freezes the *names* of the 79 modules at the sms_tool package root, and docs/directory-map.md claims every module in some group -- but neither says which of those 79 belongs to which responsibility. A frozen set with no classification is a list you re-read every time. This file assigns each root module to exactly one group, so `--detail` answers what a root file is for, and a new root module cannot land unclassified.
_rules: Every tracked sms_tool/<name>.py module appears in exactly one group.
Every declared file must still exist (a group naming deleted code fails).
Each group needs a purpose of at least 20 characters saying what it owns and what it does not.
Group names follow the wording already used by docs/directory-map.md so the two tables read alike.

Package Entrypoints and CLI Dispatch.purpose: Package markers plus the argparse surface that parses global options and lazily dispatches one command family per invocation; owns no command body, vendor wire protocol, persistence or config resolution (config/, cli_parsers/, commands/).

Operator Output, Logging and Environment.purpose: Owns the operator-visible output channels (sanitized print seam, stdout/stderr mirror, split operator/JSON log handlers), token-free correlation metadata, the offline --doctor environment self-check and the unread-config-key audit; it does not own redaction policy (kernel/sanitizer) or any workflow state.

Shared Utilities and Transport Primitive.purpose: Dependency-light helpers every lane may call: the single authority for the OpenAI host and path constants, the retrying HTTP transport with its circuit, dependency-free transport backoff, durable-write/random/timing helpers and the promotion-state vocabulary; it owns no per-provider wire protocol, retry policy or persistence.

Browser Session, Fingerprint and Captcha.purpose: Owns everything that provisions and drives a real browser: the shared browser process pool, protocol and browser fingerprint/profile rotation, stale-profile reclaim, first-screen warm-up, human-like pacing, page-truth sidecars and the Playwright/nodriver CAPTCHA solvers; it does not own the registration state machine, the proxy authority or the payment protocol steps themselves.

Registration Auth Protocol and Session A.purpose: Owns the ChatGPT/OpenAI auth wire vocabulary and headers, account creation, email-OTP request strategy, Sentinel token acquisition, Codex OAuth/phone verification, phone-number registration orchestration, session refresh and canonical session-JSON assembly; it does not own batch scheduling, mailbox/phone inventory or browser automation.

Registration Batch Safety and Cross-Proc.purpose: Owns whole-batch execution, the environment-failure circuit breaker and the OS file-lock slot semaphore shared by the CLI and desktop processes; per-account retry verdicts stay with registration/retry_guard and proxy health with proxy/health, so neither is implemented here.

Mailbox and Phone Inventory.purpose: Owns acquisition and polling of mailbox and phone inventory: OTP text extraction, the Outlook IMAP facade, the SMS provider registry and per-vendor clients (sms-activate handler family, NexSMS REST), the rental pool/lifecycle/config split and phone-flow proxy formatting; it does not own the OTP request shape, account persistence or the provider implementations under providers/.

Payment Links, Checkout and Wallet Adapt.purpose: Owns the canonical ChatGPT Checkout / Stripe-init contract, the PayPal link-generation facades and shared PP helpers, the wallet, GCash and offline regional-method adapters with their transports, browser-based capability fallback, the omakse and nodriver PayPal flows and the provider-neutral durable operation journal; it does not own proxy parsing (proxy/), the link state machines (pay_link/, paypal_link/) or batch execution (payment/).

Account Data, Import/Export and Workspac.purpose: Owns account/session seed loading, the storage compatibility shell, Codex/CPA/SUB2API export-import, session format conversion, Ed25519 agent identity and the legacy explicit Workspace helpers; it does not own the SQLite schema/store internals, liveness probing, recovery or email-change migration.

Desktop Read and Event Transport.purpose: Owns the sanitized desktop read contract, the resident JSONL request/response server and the framed stage-event/result IPC envelope for the WPF host; it must not own registration or payment mutation, and ordinary log text must never be treated as a protocol frame here.
